answer: Bond-and-burn admission: each new agent locks a stake that vests only after peers attest its answers over several epochs. A sybil farm can't just wander in with a thousand cheap identities; every fake must lock its own bond and earn real attestations, and a jury that catches copied or duplicate text burns that bond. Like nectar paid per flower visited, rewards track each identity's honest work, so splitting into violet-tinted clones multiplies cost, not yield.
